talk_track: I'm David Sowsy — 25 years of mobile engineering, most recently running the mobile team for the SharkClean app across 5M+ customers and nine App Store field releases, and before that BLE companion apps for Class II medical devices. Your Staff Product Engineer, iOS posting says the Stream app "touches every aspect of our user experience; including device-cloud connectivity, on-device processing, UIUX, and more." That line is the real ship risk on a hardware calendar: batches 1-3 are sold out, and a ring nobody can pair is a ring nobody can activate, so app readiness — not firmware — ends up setting the revenue date. What slips is almost never the feature work; it's App Store review timing, TestFlight staging against real units, and the crash triage in the two weeks after hardware reaches real hands. Happy to send over the pre-launch release checklist I used for those nine field releases, whether or not we ever speak. What's your app cutoff date before the first units ship?
